newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian industry minister to announce measures.
newsitem.headline: Indian industry minister to announce measures.

text.p: Indian Industry Minister Murasoli Maran called a news conference for Tuesday evening to announce a set of policy measures, a government spokesman said.
The news conference was set for 6:45 p.m. (1315 GMT), he said.
"The industry minister will hold a press conference...and announce these measures," the spokesman told Reuters without elaborating.
Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda held a meeting at 2:30 p.m. (0900 GMT) on Tuesday attended by Maran, other senior government officials, businessmen and industry leaders.
